title: Virtual Participant
description: The Virtual Participant's name, voice assistant, avatar, meeting-end detection and meeting chat capture.
appliesText: A saved change applies to the next Virtual Participant to start; one already in a meeting keeps the settings it started with.

displayName.title: Display name
displayName.description: The name it joins under; {LMA_USER} adds the user's name. Start with LMA; use letters, digits, - ' . _ @.

voiceAssistantProvider.title: Voice assistant
voiceAssistantProvider.description: Spoken answers: none, ElevenLabs (needs its API key on the stack), or Amazon Nova Sonic.

voiceAssistantActivationMode.title: Voice assistant activation mode
voiceAssistantActivationMode.description: Wake phrase, or always active for the whole meeting (costs more). strands_tool is not implemented yet.

voiceAssistantWakePhrases.title: Wake phrases
voiceAssistantWakePhrases.description: Comma-separated phrases that activate the voice assistant, any case.

voiceAssistantActivationDuration.title: Seconds the voice assistant stays active
voiceAssistantActivationDuration.description: How long the voice assistant stays active after a wake phrase.

elevenLabsAgentId.title: ElevenLabs agent ID
elevenLabsAgentId.description: An ElevenLabs agent for a customised voice assistant; empty for the default one.

simliFaceId.title: Simli face ID
simliFaceId.description: The Simli avatar's face; the avatar is on only when this and the Simli API key are set.

attendeePollMs.title: Teams: milliseconds between meeting checks
attendeePollMs.description: How often a Teams Virtual Participant checks whether its meeting is still running.

pollsBeforeEnd.title: Teams: checks alone before leaving
pollsBeforeEnd.description: Checks in a row showing one attendee or none before the Virtual Participant leaves.

pollsBeforeEndMissing.title: Teams: checks without a meeting before leaving
pollsBeforeEndMissing.description: Checks in a row showing no attendee count or controls before it leaves. Raise it if it leaves early.

captureMeetingChat.title: Add the meeting chat to the transcript
captureMeetingChat.description: Add messages sent to everyone in the meeting chat to the transcript (Zoom, Teams and Google Meet).

captureChatAttachments.title: Capture chat attachments
captureChatAttachments.description: Store images and files shared in the meeting chat with the meeting (up to 25 MB each).

chatAttachmentSummaries.title: AI titles and summaries for chat attachments
chatAttachmentSummaries.description: Have the Meeting assistant model title and summarize each stored chat attachment. Billed to the meeting.
